summary: Simran Kaur is a high-profile entrepreneur and media founder based in New York, specializing in financial literacy for women. She is the founder of 'Friends That Invest' and 'The Indian Feminist,' and has been recognized by Forbes 30u30 and as a Young New Zealander of the Year. Her background includes a degree in Optometry from the University of Auckland and participation in the INSEAD Women Impact Entrepreneurship Programme.
